name: reelsy-video
description: Create Canvas-visible Reelsy video and music assets, then edit confirmed projects through the production OAuth MCP and Hosted OpenCut.

interface.shortDescription: Create and edit Reelsy videos from ChatGPT
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to owner-scoped Reelsy projects through the production OAuth MCP. Generate video or instrumental music only after explicit cost confirmation, show ready assets on the Canvas, and use Hosted OpenCut when the user requests or confirms editing, combination, or export preparation. OpenCut browser exports remain local and do not create Canvas Final Artifacts.
